test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of ? will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc3cdb47a81d7b137e4741bbe58bdc1c63de979cdcc2aca99b93bca3057bdc1d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15f8d762a8562a67c747f817352ae0a57c6971a1a7337de6efd0e5bf0d3247cc.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :

1) Letter series →

The letter element shift clockwise in the sequence of:

K(11) + 3 → N(14) + 3 → Q(17) + 3 → T(20) + 3 → W(23)

2) Arrow and triangle elements →

The whole elements shift 90º anticlockwise.

The triangle element is alternately shaded.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9c4d60ef1c9a2aae26681db602f803631900b43dff7614bd1dcaa6ce99df188e.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a5c926782fad423cf246b17021fe46a07b22e6dc5d1a7e50509f314198b9fe0.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fe941a626ab5e6a88e702ab6d944cc97996cbc357ac1b8fe90fe78c8b5028e15.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b4836d8bf77af058838be9924592c6f8351fb665b5ba4ff1a2fbc7982d99b609.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
